title: The Procession
text: A line of penitents walks toward the Court, singing as they whip their own backs. Their blood spatters the road in a long red line. They ask you very kindly to walk with them a while.

options.label: Walk with the penitents and let them carry you through the Court's gates.

outcomes.text: Singing, they take you through the gates as one of theirs. Their blood is on your boots.

options.label: The wisest asks them what they repent, listening closely.

outcomes.text: Their answers draw a map of the Court's sins.

options.label: Break up the procession; this is no faith worth walking with.

outcomes.text: They do not break easily. They keep singing as they fight.
